verdict.rationale: Aleph documents bi-directional Excel and Google Sheets workflows with pull/push sync (aleph-docs-2). It also says headcount planning can be backed by spreadsheet data alongside HRIS/ATS/ERP sources (aleph-docs-4), which implies spreadsheets can feed the data model. But the evidence frames Sheets/Excel mainly as reporting front-ends and never explicitly describes uploading a file as a standalone, first-class source. missing for 10: explicit CSV/file upload documentation, confirmation that ingested spreadsheets are treated like connector sources (refresh, mapping, consolidation), independent or hands-on corroboration.
